title: Review round 1: Phase 2 attachments group chat cross-tailnet
description: Review round 1 for KITH-3yb. Covers all Phase 2 changes: kith-attach BlobStore, upload/download endpoints, Message/set attachment handling, Peer/deliver attachment + group chat, ChatSetHandler group support.
notes: Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. P0=3 P1=4 P2=7 (5 decision records + 2 real efficiency issues) P3=4 P4=4 (2 opinion-labeled). The P0s are real and concrete: sender-not-in-participants group chat exploit, a-self account alias rejected on download, and missing accountId in upload response. P1s are all real: non-transactional owner attachment write, duplicate validate_blob_id security rule, orphaned blob GC gap, silent IO error discard. The review is substantive and covers the attack surface of the new attachment and peer-delivery paths. We are running out of real complaints at P3+: the remaining open items are validation inconsistencies that have no active exploit path (content_type slash rule, filename slash rule), a de-duplication hygiene issue, and a double SQL query. The two opinion-labeled P4s (function length) have no engineering basis. The review is complete for a Phase 2 round-1 pass.
